Summary: Member and Guardian Registry
Description: Core player and parent/guardian register replacing the 43-column spreadsheet
Acceptance Criteria: Support member CRUD, sibling guardian sharing, and contact auto-sync

Summary: Registration Lifecycle and Domain Integrity
Description: Season registration workflow enforcing NFA Circular 2026/03 and junior safety rules
Acceptance Criteria: Refuse unlinked junior registrations as of Dec 31 cutoff; support adult self-registration

Summary: Team Rosters and Squad Allocation
Description: Squad building tools for coordinators and coaches
Acceptance Criteria: Create teams by age group, assign registered players, squad transfers, coach emergency sheets

Summary: Association Integration and Compliance
Description: External export and child safety compliance features
Acceptance Criteria: RFC 4180 PlayRegister CSV export and Blue Card / WWCC expiry tracking

Summary: Architecture
Description: Quality Gates and DevOps
Acceptance Criteria: System architecture documentation, CI/CD automation, and deployment hardening
Story Points: Containerization, automated tests, security untracking of .env files, and decision logs

Summary: Record and search player member profiles
Description: As the registrar, I want to add and search members by name so that the club knows who its players are.
Acceptance Criteria: Given valid player details, When registrar submits profile, Then member is saved with unique ID and appears in search results including same-name players.

Summary: Link shared parent/guardian across multiple siblings
Description: As the registrar, I want to create a guardian once and link to multiple junior siblings so that family details are not duplicated.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an existing guardian record, When linked to multiple junior siblings, Then updating guardian mobile synchronously updates contact for all linked siblings.

Summary: Enforce Junior Guardian Rule on season registration
Description: As the registrar, I want junior registrations without a linked guardian to be refused so that the club avoids insurance liability.
Acceptance Criteria: Given player is under 18 as of Dec 31 of playing season, When registration is created or marked complete without guardian, Then system throws strict domain refusal error.

Summary: Create and list teams by season and age group
Description: As the junior coordinator, I want to create teams for a season and age group so that I have squads to allocate players into.
Acceptance Criteria: Given team name, age group and season, When coordinator creates team, Then team is persisted with coach/manager schedule and filterable by age group.

Summary: Place registered players on team rosters and transfer squads
Description: As the junior coordinator, I want to place registered players into squads and move them between teams as rosters settle.
Acceptance Criteria: Given registered player, When placed on squad or moved to another team, Then player allocation succeeds and previous squad history is preserved.

Summary: View coach emergency contact sheets
Description: As a coach, I want to view my team roster with player emergency contacts so that I can reach parents in an emergency.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a coach views team roster, When emergency contact sheet is opened, Then junior players display primary guardian name and mobile phone.

Summary: Implement NFA PlayRegister CSV export
Description: As the registrar, I want to export registrations to an NFA PlayRegister CSV file so that I do not have to re-type 640 forms into the association system.
Acceptance Criteria: Given completed registrations, When registrar clicks export CSV, Then file conforms to NFA schema with RFC 4180 escaping and guardian contact mapping.

Summary: Implement Blue Card / WWCC compliance and expiry tracker
Description: As the club president, I want to track coach and manager WWCC numbers and expiry dates so that unverified officials do not take the field.
Acceptance Criteria: Given coach/manager credentials, When evaluated against kickoff, Then system flags COMPLIANT (>60d), EXPIRING_SOON (<60d), or NON_COMPLIANT/INELIGIBLE for junior squads.

Summary: Document 4-layer architecture and junior rule placement
Description: As the development team, we want to document system layers and request flow in architecture.md so that team members understand module boundaries.
Acceptance Criteria: Given system architecture, When documented in architecture.md, Then routes, services, database, client, and dual rule call sites are clearly specified.

Summary: Document Sprint 1 architectural decision log
Description: As the development team, we want to record architectural decisions in decisions.md so that technology choices are transparent.
Acceptance Criteria: Given technical trade-offs, When documented in decisions.md, Then SQLite vs PostgreSQL, foreign keys, and Git Flow branching are recorded.

Summary: Setup Docker multi-stage build and compose orchestration
Description: Containerize Node.js runtime and persistent volume storage.
Acceptance Criteria: Given application source, When docker compose up is run, Then container boots on Alpine Linux with persistent data volume and passing /api/health.

Summary: Hotfix v1.1.1: Untrack committed .env files and align CI Node matrix
Description: Fix failing GitHub Actions CI builds and remove committed credentials.
Acceptance Criteria: Given committed .env files and lockfile mismatch, When hotfix PR #5 is merged, Then .env.* files are untracked and CI passes 21/21 on Node 22.x.

Summary: Operational handover pack and quality gate certification
Description: Compile user guide, deployment verification, and formal sign-off checklist.
Acceptance Criteria: Given release v1.1.1, When handover pack is prepared, Then user manual, 21/21 test logs, and formal assessor acceptance form are verified.

Summary: Stripe payment gateway and online fee reconciliation
Description: As registrar, I want families to pay fees online with sibling discounts automatically applied.
Acceptance Criteria: Parked in Product Backlog due to PCI-DSS compliance overhead and transaction fee modeling.

Summary: Direct NFA PlayRegister automated API two-way synchronization
Description: As registrar, I want direct API sync with the NFA database.
Acceptance Criteria: Parked in Product Backlog pending formal NFA public API partnership agreement.

Summary: Visual drag-and-drop age group grading board
Description: As junior coordinator, I want to drag 40+ players across 3 squad columns on one screen.
Acceptance Criteria: Parked in Product Backlog for Sprint 4 enhancement.

Summary: Council participation and grant demographics report
Description: As president, I want 1-click reports of player counts by age and gender for council grants.
Acceptance Criteria: Parked in Product Backlog for Sprint 4 reporting epic.

Summary: Automated SMS and email wet weather broadcast
Description: As junior coordinator, I want to broadcast match cancellations via SMS to whole squads.
Acceptance Criteria: Parked in Product Backlog pending Twilio procurement in Assessment 2.
